message:
Merge pull request #265 from joho/ci/pin-windows-2025-vs2026

Point CI to new windows tag

pr.title: Point CI to new windows tag
pr.body: Per Github warming "NOTICE: windows-latest requests are being redirected to windows-2025-vs2026 by June 15, 2028"

diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index 3724f60..0ccc795 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@ jobs:
       fail-fast: false
       matrix:
         go: [ '1.26', '1.25', '1.24', '1.23', '1.22' ]
-        os: [ ubuntu-latest, macOS-latest, windows-latest ]
+        os: [ ubuntu-latest, macOS-latest, windows-2025-vs2026 ]
     name: ${{ matrix.os }} Go ${{ matrix.go }} Tests
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v6

explanation.what: ci.yml のテスト対象 OS 指定を windows-latest から windows-2025-vs2026 に変更した。
explanation.why: PR本文に引用されている GitHub の通知("windows-latest requests are being redirected to windows-2025-vs2026 by June 15, 2028")に対応し、CI が今後も想定通りの Windows イメージ上で走るよう明示的なタグに固定した。
